text: I've never seen ya 'round here. You're new, right?
zh: 我以前没在这儿见过你。你是新来的吧？

text: You again? What's up?
zh: 又是你？什么事？

text: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

text: Here, I found Hallgrim's hammer.
zh: 给，我找到了哈尔格里姆的锤子。

text: Your father gave me this letter.
zh: 你父亲让我把这封信交给你。

text: Have you made a decision about meeting your father?
zh: 见不见你父亲，你决定好了吗？

text: How was it to see your father again?
zh: 再见到你父亲，感觉怎么样？

text: Do you know where Lennard's wares are?
zh: 你知道伦纳德的货物在哪儿吗？

text: Do you have something to sell?
zh: 你有什么东西要卖吗？

text: See you!
zh: 回见！

text: I'm #:Korg:#, the smith of this camp.
zh: 我是#:科尔格:#，这个营地的铁匠。

text: Well, guess it's more accurate to say that I was the smith of this camp.
zh: 唔，准确点说，我以前是这个营地的铁匠。

text: Hallgrim took the last hammers with him, as Balder was thrown out of here. Can't do any work now.
zh: 巴尔德被赶走的时候，哈尔格里姆把最后几把锤子也带走了。现在啥活儿都干不了。

text: HAHA! Look at that!
zh: 哈哈！瞧瞧这个！

text: My father would have killed someone over this hammer right here.
zh: 为了这把锤子，我父亲能跟人拼命。

text: You know what?
zh: 你知道吗？

text: Take this axe. I made it a while ago, but I have no use for it at the moment.
zh: 拿上这把斧子吧。是我前阵子打的，眼下用不着。

text: Don't get yourself killed now!
zh: 可别把小命搭进去了！

text:
I'll tell the guard to let you pass to Goran.
Least I could do.
zh:
我会跟守卫说一声，放你过去见戈兰。
就当我尽点心意。

text: Make sure to visit me again. I might have some spare equipment layin' around.
zh: 记得再来看我。我这儿说不定还有些闲置的装备。

text: Sure thing. There's a few things I could spare. For the right price, of course!
zh: 当然有。有几样东西我可以匀出来。当然，价钱得合适！

text:
My father?
Is that true?
zh:
我父亲？
真的吗？

text: Let me see.
zh: 让我看看。

text:
That truly is my father's writing.
I am kinda surprised, you know.
zh:
这确实是我父亲的笔迹。
说实话，我挺意外的。

text:
Pop didn't use to be the best father.
After I left the capital, I could hear him screaming over the walls.
zh:
老爹以前算不上什么好父亲。
我离开王都的时候，隔着城墙都能听见他的吼声。

text:
HA, HA!
He surely was pissed.
zh:
哈，哈！
他肯定气坏了。

text:
Wait...
In his letter, he wrote, he'd like to see me again.
I could visit him at his house in the capital.
zh:
等等……
他在信里写道，他想再见见我。
我可以去王都他的家里看他。

text:
I don't know about that.
Give me some time to think this through.
zh:
这事我说不好。
给我点时间好好想想。

text: Lennard is the fool from the Icefall Village, right?
zh: 伦纳德就是冰瀑村那个傻子，对吧？

text: Nah, I don't know about his wares.
zh: 不，我不知道他的货在哪儿。

text:
Yes, I've decided.
I'm going to meet him.
zh:
嗯，我决定了。
我要去见他。

text: I still need time to think about it.
zh: 我还需要点时间考虑。

text:
What do you think?
Should I bring something?
zh:
你觉得呢？
我该带点什么去吗？

text:
But not at his house.
Instead, we're going to meet at my mother's grave, at the cemetery in the capital.
zh:
但不是在他家。
我们约在我母亲的墓前见面，就在王都的墓园里。

text: Show him the hammer, I've given you a while ago.
zh: 把我之前给你的那把锤子拿给他看。

text: How about flowers for your mother?
zh: 给你母亲带束花怎么样？

text: I don't think it is necessary to bring something.
zh: 我觉得不必带什么东西。

text:
Flowers?
Hmm...
zh:
花？
唔……

text:
That's it!
Pop's going to like that one.
zh:
就是它了！
老爹肯定会喜欢的。

text: I guess you're right.
zh: 你说得也对。

text:
Then I'll be on my way.
See you in the capital!
zh:
那我这就出发。
王都见！

text: Let's see, if the ol' flower lady still lives in the capital.
zh: 看看那位卖花的老太太还住不住在王都吧。

text: I was pretty scared, if I'm honest.
zh: 说实话，我心里挺害怕的。

text: But my old man was just happy to see me, and we had a lot to talk about.
zh: 但我老爹见到我就只是高兴，我们聊了很多。

text: I still don't want to take over his forge, but maybe I'll stop by more often.
zh: 我还是不想接手他的锻炉，不过也许我会常回去看看。

text: Anyway, thanks for helping us!
zh: 总之，谢谢你帮了我们！
